reason: The v1 campaign preregistered a fallback arm but did not freeze a generic mechanism that converts a successful fallback patch into reusable strategy memory. Without that mechanism, a decreasing fallback curve could not be causally attributed to Genesis learning. This design gap was identified after inspecting task 001 but before running any candidate or fallback evaluation.
policy: Preserve v1 as a design abort. Build a generic patch-to-strategy learner before selecting any v2 task, then freeze a fresh metadata queue excluding all v1-inspected carriers.
